chunks: The host of a gathering has the greatest right to the foremost place in his gathering.

key_terms.أَحَقُّ: more entitled or having the strongest right
key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْمَجْلِسِ: the host or owner of the gathering
key_terms.صَدْرِ مَجْلِسِهِ: the foremost or principal place of his gathering

ai.seo_question: Who has the most right to the main seat in a gathering according to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches proper etiquette in gatherings by affirming the host’s precedence regarding the principal seat of the assembly. It reflects the Prophetic sunnah (prophetic tradition) of observing social order, courtesy, and respect in communal settings.
